evaluation_role: RM development audit on held-out users and a later temporal block; retrospective
optimized_rm_role: logged observed-ratio predictor used to generate policy rewards; not ground truth
external_audit_role: separately fitted ExtraTrees predictor; diagnostics only, never used for beta/checkpoint selection

prior_provenance.fit_prior_source: all known, non-organic, unambiguous F_RM events strictly earlier than every selected RM fit target
prior_provenance.policy_prior_source: all known, non-organic, unambiguous F_RM events, before V_RM and A_RL
prior_provenance.prior_change_test: feature priors are computed on rows with timestamp < cutoff; later targets cannot enter the aggregation query
prior_provenance.embedding_source: not used by RM fit; frozen full_model strong actor embeddings are used only for the separate policy candidate-history interaction feature

fit_sample.selection: stable SHA256 per user/target, fixed before reading outcomes

audit_sample.role: disjoint audit users, later V_RM targets
audit_sample.selection: stable SHA256 per user/target, fixed before reading outcomes

limitations: The outcome data was inspected in V1-full_model. Disjoint users and temporal blocks improve role separation but do not create an untouched dataset.
All RM comparisons are on logged actions; a lower error does not establish counterfactual ranking quality.
The external audit predictor is separate from the optimized RM but shares the same permitted fit sample and is not ground truth.
The policy feature extractor uses a pretrained strong actor. Its relationship to A_RL event exposure is disclosed separately.
